text:
ida: Ran an nsys trace on the perf-cluster after the KV-cache change — saw a concentrated SM util spike and a handful of long kernels between 1.2s-1.8s GPU time, conv_mm_128x64 and attn_qk_kv_dot top the list.
mike: can you paste the top-k numbers?
ida: sure
```text
Top kernels by GPU time (nsys summary)
1) conv_mm_128x64    42.1%
2) attn_qk_kv_dot    28.3%
3) kv_retrieve_small  9.7%
4) softmax_drop       6.5%
5) other              13.4%
```
raj: odd that conv dominates — did batch sizes or kernel selection change in the new quant path?
lucy: occupancy dump shows conv_mm has ~98% SM util but low achieved occupancy (regs/block high) -> long warp latency, looks like register pressure/regalloc change after recompile.
mike: quick diff commands I used: 
```bash
nsys profile -o out_old --trace=cuda ./serve --config cfg_old.yaml
nsys profile -o out_new --trace=cuda ./serve --config cfg_new_quant.yaml
nsys stats out_old.qdrep out_new.qdrep --report=kernel
```
perf-bot: nsys reports uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/3645000000/nsys_report.zip :file_folder: 
ida: comparing timelines, conv_mm kernel runs overlap heavy KV retrieval bursts — L2 read BW looks saturated during that window (perfetto slice attached). The overlap increases wall time because conv path doesn't yield while waiting on L2.
raj: so two suspects: (1) kernel selection now chooses conv_mm fused path for matmul+reduce post-quantization, (2) KV cache prefetch pattern changed so retrieval happens concurrently with expensive conv, choking L2.
lucy: hypothesis: the quantized kernel's register footprint prevented the alternate attn_kv_dot variant from being chosen, so we get a pathological combo. Could bias selector to attn_kv_split for seq>512.
mike: as a tactical mitigation we can lower batcher.max_batch from 16->8 and throttle prefetch concurrency to 2 to reduce L2 storms. Can run A/B on canary.
ida: I extracted a short perfetto trace snippet with nvtx markers: 
```text
[00:12.340] prefetch(kv) start
[00:12.352] conv_mm_128x64 start
[00:13.540] conv_mm_128x64 end
[00:13.542] kv_retrieve_small end
```
That ~1.2s conv window is where most extra GPU time accumulates.
mike: I'll try a kernel-selector patch that prefers attn_kv_split for sequences >512 and add a flag --prefersplit for test. Running on canary now.
ida: opened INF-937 to track the regression and link traces/PRs. I'll attach the nvprof/nsys snippet in the ticket.
lucy: small note: also check launch configuration (block/x threads) differences between old/new PTX after quant. regs_per_thread jumped in new build.
mike: quick canary results: lowered batch->8 reduced conv GPU time fraction 42.1%->29.6% and tail latency improved ~18%. Patch to selector (w/ --prefersplit) reduces top-k conv occurrences by ~80% in our runs. Posting logs soon. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: canary deploy started (nodes 3/3)
ida: thanks — assigning follow-ups: mike -> selector PR, lucy -> register/regalloc review, raj -> prefetch concurrency tuning.
mike: ETA 2h for PR and perf artifact. I'll post traces here when done.
